items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: We went in the studio to record. Sammy. And Sammy couldn't sing harmony.

ctx.x: Sammy. Yes, Sammy. We went in the studio. This is on Governor Nichols. We went in the studio to record. Sammy. And Sammy couldn't sing harmony. Every time we would start singing, he would be pulled into my part. A little while. Yeah. And so, oh, well we lost a few dollars trying to do this thing. So we had to put it off. And then, I don't know if you listen to it, but the other voice is Johnny Adams. Oh, is it?
The other voice in there is Johnny Adams? Yeah, that's Johnny Adams.
